people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: So Moses the servant of Yahweh died there in the land of Moab, according to Yahweh’s word.
translations.bsb: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, as the LORD had said.
translations.kjv: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the LORD.
translations.asv: So Moses the servant of Jehovah died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of Jehovah.
